pass.answer: Before we start the binary-search-trees workspace: what's the reason you want to understand deletion, is it for an interview, a course, or code you're writing?

fail.answer: Deletion has three cases. A leaf is just removed; a node with one child is replaced by it; a node with two children takes the value of its in-order successor. Why are you learning this?
The tricky case is a node with two children. What's your goal?
